items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: The interviewee mentions 'Ed' in the context of sneaking into dances with their sister, but the interviewer clarifies 'Big Ed' is their own buddy Eddie Johnson, not the person the interviewee knew. The interviewee does not claim a personal relationship with 'Big Ed'.

ctx.x: These girls managed to get married off to musicians. He's done. Now... Did you sit in with any of those bands when they came over there?

Well... I was quite young then, at times... I used to slip out and go. See? I used to slip out and go because my daddy wouldn't let me and my other sister hadn't been going. We would steal away and go, you see? Slip out. Papa would go to bed. Papa would go to bed. Me and I hadn't been gone. We slipped out and gone to the dance. You were still a martyr. Yeah, we still a martyr. And Sadie would be playing those dances. Lots of my older sister Sadie. She would be playing them dances. Sadie would see me. I'd be done…
Who of your sisters used to work with bands over there?
